project.name: CodeWitness :: Pascal Adapter
project.description: Pascal language adapter: unit and program detection, Free Pascal compilation with diagnostics, fpcunit test discovery, compilation and execution with TAP and XML reporting, heuristic and security analysis, bounded source mutation, and scenario-generated tests. Free Pascal is the only tool required, and the fpcunit framework the adapter drives ships with it, so a tree with no external dependencies needs nothing else.
